rubric_items.reason: All four acceptance criteria (ticket L16-L20) map to REQ-1, REQ-2, REQ-4, REQ-5; job timing is listed under Out of scope with a reason.

REQs are mostly atomic and checkable. REQ-2 now has a single 24h window and REQ-15 states the resulting state. REQ-6 bundles the cancelled and No-show cases and says 'within the one day' instead of 24h.
Every known REQ cites the ticket, an IDE answer or the answered Q-01. REQ-10 now rests on the product owner's Q-01 answer and A-07; the uncited 'first background job' summary line is gone.

The clash with glossary#scheduled is asked and recorded as a mismatch. No mismatch records that rescheduling (Q-01) departs from it, or that cancelling a past Stale appointment departs from glossary#cancelled.
No questions remain open. Q-01 went to the product owner as a blocking question with a clear scope, and the reschedule-result assumption was confirmed in A-07.
Plain and mostly consistent. REQ-6 still says 'the one day' where the other REQs use '24h after its start time'.

findings.text: REQ-10 lets staff reschedule a Stale appointment, but glossary#scheduled says only Scheduled appointments can change. Q-01's answer is not in the answers list, and neither it nor A-07 records this mismatch (A-03's mismatch covers closing only).

cites.quote: Staff can also `reschedule` a Stale appointment.

findings.suggested_fix: Add a mismatch to A-07 (or an answers entry for Q-01) saying rescheduling a Stale appointment departs from glossary#scheduled.

findings.text: REQ-9 lets staff cancel a Stale appointment, which by REQ-2 is more than 24h past its start. Glossary#cancelled defines Cancelled as called off before it took place. A-03's mismatch does not record this difference.

cites.quote: Staff can still cancel a Stale appointment `with a reason`.
An appointment called off before it took place, with a reason

findings.suggested_fix: Extend A-03's mismatch to note that cancelling a past Stale appointment departs from glossary#cancelled.

findings.text: REQ-6 says 'within the one day' while REQ-2, REQ-4 and REQ-5 use '24h after its start time' (A-02). It also bundles the cancelled and No-show cases into one REQ.

cites.quote: An appointment cancelled or marked No-show within the one day is no longer `Scheduled` and is not marked Stale.

findings.suggested_fix: Use 'within 24h after its start time' in REQ-6. Optionally split it into a cancelled case and a No-show case.

cites.quote: closed by staff once its start time has passed
